patterns.note: The main page title is fixed at the top, acting as a large, static overlay while content scrolls underneath.
Large, vertically-oriented images are centrally aligned, with accompanying text blocks positioned to their left or right, creating an asymmetrical balance.
The primary heading uses an extremely large, bold, condensed sans-serif typeface, creating a dominant visual anchor.
A consistent light blue background provides a calm, expansive canvas for the vibrant photography and bold typography.
The oversized 'CITY OF ANGELS' title remains fixed in the viewport, creating a foreground layer, while large photographic sections and their descriptive text scroll vertically behind it.
Each scroll depth reveals a new full-height photographic section paired with a distinct block of editorial text or a quote, creating a clear narrative flow.

technique_notes: The main page title is implemented as a fixed element, positioned to overlay the scrolling content, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections are composed of large, centrally-aligned images, with associated text blocks floated to either side, ensuring visual interest with each new section.

The motion system employs a fixed foreground element (the main title) over a vertically scrolling background of full-bleed images and text, giving the impression that the content slides beneath the title.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold, condensed hero title (~8-10x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp; all elements maintain crisp, angular edges.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; generous negative space around the fixed title and between scrolling content blocks, emphasizing individual elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a massive, fixed, and brightly colored title as a persistent foreground element, through which large editorial images and text scroll, creates a powerful, magazine-like experience. This bold typographic statement combined with the dynamic background scroll makes the site feel both monumental and intimate.
